title: People & Everyday Objects
subtitle: Name the people around you, colors, and common objects.

content.intro: These words appear everywhere — in conversations, in classrooms, on this website. Learn a few at a time.

rules.heading: Family
rules.body: mother / mom, father / dad, sister, brother, son, daughter, husband, wife, friend

rules.heading: Colors
rules.body: red, blue, green, yellow, black, white, orange, purple, pink, brown, gray

rules.heading: Common objects
rules.body: book, pen, pencil, phone, table, chair, bag, door, window, computer, key, watch

examples: This is my mother. Her name is Ana.
The book is on the table.

exercises.title: Match the Word to Its Picture Description

pairs.right: something you use to call people
something you use to open a door

items.explanation: Connecting a word with its everyday use helps you remember it.
A pen or pencil is used for writing.

items.prompt: Which word is a family member?

summary: Family words: mother, father, sister, brother, son, daughter.
Main colors: red, blue, green, yellow, black, white, and more.
Everyday objects: book, pen, phone, table, chair, key.
